ucs.title: [LLM] Transparent Tribe (APT36 / Mythic Leopard) CrimsonRAT staging from archive-borne defence lure
ucs.description: Hunts APT36's signature Windows delivery chain — a RAR/ZIP/IMG/ISO extracted from email or Downloads spawning a .NET executable in a user-writable directory, with the binary either using a double extension (.pdf.exe) or carrying Indian defence / MoD / PSU lure keywords typical of Mythic Leopard's spearphishing themes against Indian Army, MoD, CGDA and government targets. This combination is the textbook CrimsonRAT / CapraRAT / ObliqueRAT staging pattern that COPPER FIELDSTONE has reused for years and is far more specific than generic archive→exec hunts.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winrar.exe","7z.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winzip64.exe","bandizip.exe","explorer.exe","outlook.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("*.exe","*.scr","*.pif","*.com") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Desktop\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process_name,"(?i)\.(pdf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|pps|ppsx|jpg|jpeg|png)\.(exe|scr|pif|com)$") OR match(process_name,"(?i)(invitation|invite|advisory|brief|posting|orbat|salary|appraisal|defence|defense|army|navy|naval|airforce|operation|ministry|pension|cgda|secretariat|jawan|transfer|rashtriya|drdo|isro)") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Public\", @"\Desktop\"]);
let ArchiveOrMail = dynamic(["winrar.exe","7z.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winzip64.exe","bandizip.exe","explorer.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let LureKeywords = dynamic(["invitation","invite","advisory","brief","posting","orbat","salary","appraisal","defence","defense","army","navy","naval","airforce","operation","ministry","pension","cgda","secretariat","jawan","drdo","isro","rashtriya"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ArchiveOrMail)
| where FolderPath has_any (UserWritable)
| where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".scr" or FileName endswith ".pif" or FileName endswith ".com"
| where ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !in~ ("Microsoft Corporation","Google LLC","Mozilla Corporation","Adobe Inc.","Citrix Systems, Inc.","VMware, Inc.")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FileNameLower = tolower(FileName)
| extend DoubleExtension = FileNameLower matches regex @"\.(pdf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|pps|ppsx|jpg|jpeg|png)\.(exe|scr|pif|com)$"
| extend LureMatch = FileNameLower has_any (LureKeywords)
| extend DotNetIndicator = ProcessVersionInfoProductName has_any ("Microsoft .NET",".NET Framework") or ProcessVersionInfoFileDescription has ".NET"
| where DoubleExtension or LureMatch or DotNetIndicator
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, FileSize, DoubleExtension, LureMatch, DotNetIndicator
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ArchiveOrMail = dynamic(["winrar.exe","7z.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winzip64.exe","bandizip.exe","explorer.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Public\", @"\Desktop\"]);
let LureKeywords = dynamic(["invitation","advisory","brief","posting","orbat","salary","defence","defense","army","navy","naval","airforce","ministry","pension","cgda","secretariat","jawan","drdo","isro"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| where ParentName in~ (ArchiveOrMail)
| extend NewProcLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where NewProcLower has_any (UserWritable)
| where NewProcLower endswith ".exe" or NewProcLower endswith ".scr" or NewProcLower endswith ".pif" or NewProcLower endswith ".com"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend DoubleExtension = NewProcLower matches regex @"\.(pdf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|pps|ppsx|jpg|jpeg|png)\.(exe|scr|pif|com)$"
| extend LureMatch = NewProcLower has_any (LureKeywords)
| where DoubleExtension or LureMatch
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, DoubleExtension, LureMatch
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Transparent Tribe (APT36) CrimsonRAT staging from archive lure
id: a36-crimson-stage-001
status: experimental
description: Detects APT36 signature delivery — archive utility or mail client extracts an executable into a user-writable directory with a double extension or Indian defence-themed lure name, the chain used to stage CrimsonRAT / CapraRAT / ObliqueRAT against Indian military and government targets.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134/
author: detection-eng
date: 2026/06/02
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.execution
    - attack.defense_evasion
    - attack.t1566.001
    - attack.t1204.002
    - attack.t1036.005
    - attack.g0134
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\winrar.exe'
            - '\7z.exe'
            - '\7zg.exe'
            - '\7zfm.exe'
            - '\winzip64.exe'
            - '\bandizip.exe'
            - '\explorer.exe'
            - '\outlook.exe'
    selection_path:
        Image|contains:
            - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
            - '\AppData\Roaming\'
            - '\Downloads\'
            - '\Public\'
            - '\Desktop\'
    selection_ext:
        Image|endswith:
            - '.exe'
            - '.scr'
            - '.pif'
            - '.com'
    selection_lure:
        Image|re|i: '(\.(pdf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|pps|ppsx|jpg|jpeg|png)\.(exe|scr|pif|com)$)|(invitation|advisory|brief|posting|orbat|salary|defence|defense|army|navy|naval|airforce|ministry|pension|cgda|secretariat|jawan|drdo|isro)'
    condition: selection_parent and selection_path and selection_ext and selection_lure
falsepositives:
    - IT-distributed signed installers extracted from internal archives — validate signer field
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winrar.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\7z.exe OR *\\7zg.exe OR *\\7zfm.exe OR *\\winzip64.exe OR *\\bandizip.exe OR *\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE) @Image:(*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\Desktop\\*) @Image:(*.exe OR *.EXE OR *.scr OR *.SCR OR *.pif OR *.com) (@Image:(*.pdf.exe OR *.doc.exe OR *.docx.exe OR *.xls.exe OR *.xlsx.exe OR *.ppt.exe OR *.pptx.exe OR *.jpg.exe OR *.png.exe OR *.PDF.exe OR *.DOC.exe) OR @Image:(*invitation* OR *advisory* OR *brief* OR *orbat* OR *defence* OR *defense* OR *army* OR *navy* OR *airforce* OR *ministry* OR *pension* OR *cgda* OR *secretariat* OR *jawan* OR *drdo* OR *isro*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(winrar|7z|7zg|7zfm|winzip64|bandizip|explorer|outlook)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|Downloads|Public|Desktop)\\/i
| ImageFileName=/\.(exe|scr|pif|com)$/i
| (ImageFileName=/\.(pdf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|pps|ppsx|jpg|jpeg|png)\.(exe|scr|pif|com)$/i OR ImageFileName=/(invitation|advisory|brief|posting|orbat|salary|defence|defense|army|navy|naval|airforce|ministry|pension|cgda|secretariat|jawan|drdo|isro)/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Three independent APT36 signatures stack: (1) archive/mail-client parent dropping executable to user-writable path (their delivery primitive since the Operation C-Major days), (2) double-extension masquerade (.pdf.exe / .docx.exe used in MoD-themed lures), and (3) Indian defence / paramilitary / PSU lure vocabulary (CGDA, ORBAT, DRDO, Rashtriya, Jawan, MoD) which other state actors do not use. Gen
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] Transparent Tribe (APT36) Linux Poseidon/GLOBSHELL .desktop weaponization on BOSS Linux targets
ucs.description: Hunts APT36's distinctive Linux delivery against BOSS Linux desktops used by Indian government and defence personnel — a malicious .desktop launcher (often disguised as a PDF) opened via xdg-open / nautilus / gio that spawns bash/sh and pipes curl or wget to a shell, decodes base64, or writes/executes an ELF from /tmp. Transparent Tribe is one of very few tracked actors that ships custom Linux implants (Poseidon, GLOBSHELL, ElizaRAT-linked tooling) for this OS, so the technique combination is essentially actor-attributable.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("xdg-open","gio","gnome-open","kde-open","mimeopen","nautilus","caja","dbus-daemon","gnome-shell") AND Processes.process_name IN ("bash","sh","dash","zsh","ksh") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process,"(?i)(curl|wget)[^|]{0,400}\|\s*(bash|sh|python|perl)") OR match(process,"(?i)\bbase64\s+(-d|--decode)\b") OR match(process,"/dev/tcp/") OR match(process,"(?i)chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp/") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let DesktopDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName endswith ".desktop"
    | where FolderPath startswith "/home/" or FolderPath startswith "/tmp/" or FolderPath startswith "/var/tmp/" or FolderPath has "/Downloads/" or FolderPath has "/Desktop/"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("firefox","chrome","chromium","thunderbird","evolution","wget","curl","tar","unzip","unar","ark","file-roller","engrampa")
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              DropPath = strcat(FolderPath, FileName),
              DropParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("xdg-open","gio","gnome-open","kde-open","mimeopen","nautilus","caja","dbus-daemon","gnome-shell")
| where FileName in~ ("bash","sh","dash","zsh","ksh")
| extend Cmd = ProcessCommandLine
| where Cmd matches regex @"(?i)(curl|wget)[^|]{0,400}\|\s*(bash|sh|python|perl)"
     or Cmd matches regex @"(?i)\bbase64\s+(-d|--decode)\b"
     or Cmd has "/dev/tcp/"
     or Cmd matches regex @"(?i)\bchmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp/"
| join kind=leftouter DesktopDrops on DeviceId
| where isnull(DropTime) or (Timestamp between (DropTime .. DropTime + 10m))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ShellCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          RecentDesktopDrop = DropPath,
          DroppedBy = DropParent,
          DelaySec = iff(isnull(DropTime), int(null), datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, DropTime))
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DvcOs has "Linux" or ActingProcessName in~ ("bash","sh","dash","zsh","ksh")
| where ParentProcessName in~ ("xdg-open","gio","gnome-open","kde-open","mimeopen","nautilus","caja","dbus-daemon","gnome-shell")
| where ActingProcessName in~ ("bash","sh","dash","zsh","ksh")
| extend Cmd = ActingProcessCommandLine
| where Cmd matches regex @"(?i)(curl|wget)[^|]{0,400}\|\s*(bash|sh|python|perl)"
     or Cmd matches regex @"(?i)\bbase64\s+(-d|--decode)\b"
     or Cmd has "/dev/tcp/"
     or Cmd matches regex @"(?i)\bchmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp/"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Transparent Tribe (APT36) .desktop file shell payload on Linux
id: a36-desktop-linux-001
status: experimental
description: Detects APT36 signature Linux delivery on BOSS Linux / Ubuntu government endpoints — a desktop launcher (xdg-open / nautilus / gio / mimeopen) spawning a shell that pipes curl or wget to bash, decodes base64, or chmods+executes from /tmp. This is the .desktop file abuse used to stage Poseidon and GLOBSHELL against Indian government Linux users.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134/
author: detection-eng
date: 2026/06/02
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.command_and_control
    - attack.t1204.002
    - attack.t1059.004
    - attack.t1105
    - attack.g0134
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: linux
detection:
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '/xdg-open'
            - '/gio'
            - '/gnome-open'
            - '/kde-open'
            - '/mimeopen'
            - '/nautilus'
            - '/caja'
            - '/dbus-daemon'
            - '/gnome-shell'
    selection_shell:
        Image|endswith:
            - '/bash'
            - '/sh'
            - '/dash'
            - '/zsh'
            - '/ksh'
    selection_chain:
        CommandLine|re|i:
            - '(curl|wget)[^|]{0,400}\|\s*(bash|sh|python|perl)'
            - '\bbase64\s+(-d|--decode)\b'
            - '/dev/tcp/'
            - '\bchmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp/'
    condition: selection_parent and selection_shell and selection_chain
falsepositives:
    - Developer-written .desktop launchers running install scripts (validate originating package)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.executable.path:(*/bash OR */sh OR */dash OR */zsh OR */ksh) (@process.command_line:(*curl* AND *\|* AND (*bash* OR *sh*)) OR @process.command_line:(*wget* AND *\|* AND (*bash* OR *sh*)) OR @process.command_line:(*"base64 -d"* OR *"base64 --decode"*) OR @process.command_line:*"/dev/tcp/"* OR @process.command_line:(*"chmod +x /tmp/"* OR *"chmod +x /tmp/."*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(xdg-open|gio|gnome-open|kde-open|mimeopen|nautilus|caja|dbus-daemon|gnome-shell)$/i
| ImageFileName=/\/(bash|sh|dash|zsh|ksh)$/i
| (CommandLine=/(curl|wget)[^|]{0,400}\|\s*(bash|sh|python|perl)/i OR CommandLine=/\bbase64\s+(-d|--decode)\b/i OR regex("/dev/tcp/", field=CommandLine) OR CommandLine=/\bchmod\s+\+x\s+\/tmp\//i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Linux-side EDR coverage is sparse across most actors — the unique combination of (a) a desktop-environment opener (xdg-open / nautilus / gio / mimeopen) as parent, (b) a shell as child, and (c) curl|sh / base64 -d / chmod +x /tmp/ in the command line is essentially impossible to produce legitimately on a government end-user workstation. APT36 is one of the only state crews actively delivering ELF
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID
